children: The European Union announced temporary measures to support and boost trade with Armenia on Wednesday after Russia imposed restrictions on the country.

The EU said there would be a temporary suspension of import duties for a broad range of Armenian products, including selected agricultural products subject to tariff-rate quotas, adding that the steps would liberalise around 80% of Armenian exports to the EU.
Russia has announced trade restrictions upon Armenia, as its once-close ally seeks deeper ties with Brussels and Washington.
